pages.text: Akaishi Energy is the mod's equivalent of electricity; almost every machine operates on it.$(br2)$(bold)Rule:$(reset) automation requires a powered grid first.$(br2)A power grid performs four functions:$(li)Generate: the $(l:akaishi:generator)Energy Generator$(/l) converts fuel into power; the Reactor and Fusion Reactor provide larger output later$(li)Store: $(l:akaishi:energy_cell)Energy Cells$(/l)$(li)Transport: $(l:akaishi:energy_pipe)Energy Pipes$(/l) carry power to machines$(li)Carry: $(l:akaishi:portable_cell)Portable Cells$(/l) provide power away from the base$(br2)The order is fixed: generator first, then cells, then pipes connecting the machines into one grid.

$(bold)Five fuel tiers$(reset) (heating value, low to high):$(li)Akaishi Crystal$(li)Raw Akaishi Block$(li)Akaishi Essence$(li)Condensed Akaishi Essence$(li)Condensed Akaishi Essence Block$(br2)Each tier is approximately 10× the previous heating value and is obtained through the chain described in $(l:akaishi:crystal)Crystal & Essence$(/l).$(br2)$(bold)Number notation:$(reset) machine interfaces abbreviate large values: K = thousand, M = million, B = billion. Refining fuel further increases both burn duration and output; one additional refining step reduces the number of refills by ten.
Reading order after this entry: Energy Generator, then Energy Cells, then Energy Pipes, to complete the first power grid.
